description: This file defines utilities and classes for handling sparse CSR (Compressed Sparse Row) tensors in PyTorch, including layout checks, tensor conversions, and operations specific to sparse compressed tensors.

classes.name: CheckSparseTensorInvariants
classes.description: RAII class to manage the checking of sparse tensor invariants within a scope.

methods.name: is_sparse_compressed
methods.description: Checks if a given layout or tensor is a sparse compressed layout.

methods.name: get_sparse_csr_impl
methods.description: Retrieves the internal SparseCsrTensorImpl pointer from a SparseCsrTensor.

methods.name: layoutToString
methods.description: Converts a sparse layout enum to a string representation.

methods.name: isCompressedRow
methods.description: Determines if a layout is a compressed row layout.

methods.name: isCompressedColumn
methods.description: Determines if a layout is a compressed column layout.

methods.name: compressedIndicesName
methods.description: Returns the name of the compressed indices tensor based on layout.

methods.name: plainIndicesName
methods.description: Returns the name of the plain indices tensor based on layout.

methods.name: compressedDimName
methods.description: Returns the dimension name ('row', 'column', etc.) for a given layout.

methods.name: plainDimName
methods.description: Returns the plain dimension name ('column', 'row', etc.) for a given layout.

methods.name: rowDimension
methods.description: Calculates the row dimension size based on layout and tensor size.

methods.name: columnDimension
methods.description: Calculates the column dimension size based on layout and tensor size.

methods.name: compressedDimension
methods.description: Calculates the compressed dimension size.

methods.name: plainDimension
methods.description: Calculates the plain dimension size.

methods.name: numBatchDimensions
methods.description: Returns the number of batch dimensions for a sparse tensor.

methods.name: getCompressedPlainIndices
methods.description: Returns the pair of compressed and plain indices tensors.

methods.name: getIndexDtype
methods.description: Returns the scalar type of indices for a sparse tensor.

methods.name: flip_compressed_layout
methods.description: Switches between CSR and CSC layouts, or BSR and BSC.

methods.name: getBlockSize
methods.description: Retrieves the block size of a sparse BSR/BSC tensor.

methods.name: getSymIntBlockSize
methods.description: Retrieves symbolic block size if available.

methods.name: only_sparse_compressed_binary_op_trivial_cases
methods.description: Checks for trivial cases in binary operations on sparse compressed tensors.

methods.name: only_sparse_compressed_add_trivial_cases
methods.description: Checks for trivial addition cases in sparse compressed tensors.

methods.name: to_type
methods.description: Converts a sparse tensor to a different scalar type.

methods.name: create_acc_buffer
methods.description: Creates accumulation buffers for sparse tensor operations.

methods.name: copy_from_acc_buffer
methods.description: Copies data from accumulation buffer to tensor.
